info.name: Reports
info.description:
Clean report-data collection for Postman.

Run Login first. Login stores TOKEN in environment and globals so this separate Reports collection can use it.
Default date is 30 Jul 2026 full day because that is the current production screen date being verified.
The first request uses clean=1, so Postman shows a professional response with records, summary, pagination, PLC shot details, OP150 leak-test data, and shot summary without duplicate frontend aliases.
Optional filters are present but disabled by default. Enable only the filter you want in Postman.

variable.description: Default full-day start for current verification date.
Default full-day end for current verification date.
Records per page. Increase only if needed.
Paste internal part ID here, then run Search by Part ID.
Paste customer QR/customer code here, then run Search by Customer QR.
Paste PLC shot number here, then run Search by Shot Number.

item.name: 1. Report Records - Same As Report Page
item.description: Start here. This fetches records exactly like a professional report API response: rows, metrics, pagination, PLC columns, available shifts, PLC shot summary, and leak-test details.

Optional status filter: OK, NG, IN_PROGRESS.
